descricao.message: Opens the URL you choose in every new tab. No tracking, only the storage permission.

rotuloUrls.message: One URL per line (lines starting with # are ignored). https:// is optional.

escolhaAleatoria.message: Pick one at random for each tab

aberturaSubstituir.message: Redirect: works with any site. Focus moves to the page and “Back” does not return to the new tab.

aberturaAba.message: Navigate the tab (tabs.update): the browser performs the navigation and the address shows normally in the address bar.

aberturaMoldura.message: Frame: focus stays in the address bar (you can start typing right away), but many sites refuse to be shown this way and logins may fail (third-party cookies). Good for your own pages or local files.

rotuloReserva.message: Fallback URL when the browser is offline (optional, e.g. a local file):

rotuloSync.message: Sync these settings with the Edge profile account (uncheck to keep settings on this computer only).

avisoArquivo.message: Some URLs use file://: turn on “Allow access to file URLs” in this extension's details at edge://extensions.

botaoTestar.message: Save and open a new tab

erroEsquema.message: Scheme "$1" is not allowed (use http, https or file).

erroNaoEndereco.message: "$1" does not look like an address.

novaGuiaSairMoldura.message: Open this page directly in the tab

semUrlTexto.message: Choose which page should open in every new tab.

offlineTexto.message: The browser is offline. Try again when the connection is back.

arquivoTitulo.message: Local file access is not allowed

arquivoTexto.message: At edge://extensions, open this extension's “Details” and turn on “Allow access to file URLs”. Then try again.

erroTitulo.message: Could not open the new tab
